Step 2: From rule “Young people are kind” and Step 1, Harry is kind. (Young → Kind)  
Step 3: From rule “If someone is kind then they are green” and Step 2, Harry is green. (Kind → Green)  
Step 4: From rule “If someone is green then they are smart” and Step 3, Harry is smart. (Green → Smart)  

ANSWER: True

6. If someone is green then smart. (green => smart)

We need to prove Harry smart. We have fact: Harry rough, young. By rule 3: young => kind. So Harry kind.

From kind => green. So Harry green.

From green => smart. So Harry smart.

Thus conclusion True.
